items.signal_prefix: CFO: R&D expense was approximately CAD 19.7 million

set.signal: CFO: R&D expense was approximately $19.7 million, up $2.4 million from Q1 2026 on headcount and stock-based compensation as manufacturing and engineering teams grow; G&A approximately $11.1 million (vs $9.8 million); adjusted EBITDA loss $21.3 million (vs $13.9 million in Q1 2026), driven by higher R&D and G&A and lower grant revenue. Cash at quarter end was $312.8 million (amounts as spoken on the call; the call transcript prints them as 'CAD', but Xanadu's Q2 2026 release, Xanadu 6-K (08-05-2026), presents all figures in United States dollars).
set.figure: R&D ~$19.7 million; adjusted EBITDA loss $21.3 million; $312.8 million cash (U.S. dollars per the 6-K)

items.label: Xanadu Q2 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CFO: capex increased to approximately CAD 6.4 million

set.signal: CFO: capex increased to approximately $6.4 million in the quarter, mainly specialized equipment to test, refine and scale chip manufacturing (amounts as spoken on the call; the call transcript prints them as 'CAD', but Xanadu's Q2 2026 release, Xanadu 6-K (08-05-2026), presents all figures in United States dollars). Xanadu gives no explicit guidance, but expects R&D growth to accelerate into Q3 and capex to increase further in the second half as it adds engineering talent and increases tapeouts — operating spend and capex should 'grow substantially in the second half of the year'; more color at its Analyst Day.

items.reason: same: U.S. dollar reporting currency (6-K: capital expenditures approximately $6.4 million)
